episodes.title: My Experience in the Jehovah's Witnesses Cult 4 PM
episodes.description:
What was life really like inside the Jehovah's Witnesses community? 😨

In this powerful personal story, I share my experience with the Jehovah's Witnesses, including shocking memories, emotional struggles, strict beliefs, personal challenges, and the journey of questioning everything.

This is a deeply personal account that reveals a side of life many people may never have experienced.

😱 Watch until the end to discover the full story!
